articles.title: OpenAI发布Dots智能体助手
articles.summary: OpenAI在开发者大会推出Dots，一种常驻后台、能跨应用帮你干活的AI助手，由GPT-6 Astra模型驱动。
articles.why: AI助手从「你问它答」变成「它主动帮你做事」，这是普通人用AI方式的一次明显变化。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 可以留意：以后AI工具会不会都变成这种「后台帮你干活」的形态？
articles.source_title: OpenAI launches Dots, its Muse competitor

articles.title: 特朗普下令官方改称「超级智能」
articles.summary: 特朗普签署行政令，要求联邦政府文件统一把AI叫「超级智能」，并称现有法律足以应对风险。
articles.why: AI的政策风向和叫法在变，普通人了解AI时可能会看到越来越多新名词。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 遇到「超级智能」这个词时，知道它指的就是AI就行。
articles.source_title: Trump orders US government to call AI ‘Super Intelligence’
articles.new_development: 特朗普签署行政令，要求联邦文件统一改称超级智能

articles.title: OpenAI暂不上市，先谈安全
articles.summary: OpenAI CEO奥特曼表示，公司要等能对模型安全作出更可靠承诺后才会考虑上市，目前没有时间表。
articles.why: 头部AI公司把安全放在上市之前，说明行业对AI风险的重视程度在上升。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 可以观察：AI公司说的「安全」具体指什么，会不会影响产品功能？
articles.source_title: Sam Altman says OpenAI won’t go public until its models are safe

articles.title: DeepSeek Harness桌面版上线
articles.summary: DeepSeek推出Harness桌面端预览版，主打「万物皆插件」，更像一个个人助理工具。
articles.why: 国产AI工具在往桌面端和插件化方向走，新手多了一个可以上手的AI助手选择。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 可以试试：桌面版AI助手和网页版用起来有什么不一样？
articles.source_title: DeepSeek Harness桌面版实测：更像「个人助理」，还给你送钱

articles.title: OpenAI推出类办公套件功能
articles.summary: OpenAI发布一批办公功能，把ChatGPT变成能发现和使用软件的地方，直接对标传统办公软件。
articles.why: 以后写文档、做表格可能直接在ChatGPT里完成，对日常办公和学习方式有实际影响。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 留意：你平时用的办公软件会不会被AI聊天工具替代一部分？
articles.source_title: OpenAI takes on Microsoft with the launch of what feels a whole lot like ChatGPT’s own office suite

articles.title: AI研究者发视频警告超级智能风险
articles.summary: 多位来自OpenAI、谷歌、Anthropic的研究者发视频称超级智能「危险程度和听起来一样」，有人估计人类灭绝概率约五成。
articles.why: 做AI的人自己出来谈风险，提醒普通人关注AI安全不只是科幻话题。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 可以想一个问题：为什么造AI的人反而最担心AI？
articles.source_title: AI researchers put out videos saying superintelligence is ‘exactly as dangerous as it sounds’

articles.title: OpenAI洽谈300亿美元融资
articles.summary: 据报道OpenAI正洽谈融资300亿美元，估值达1.4万亿美元，可能是2027年上市前最后一轮。
articles.why: AI头部公司资金规模惊人，说明这个行业还在高速扩张，新工具和新服务会持续涌现。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 不用记数字，知道AI公司现在很「烧钱」也很「吸金」就够了。
articles.source_title: OpenAI reportedly in talks to raise $30B round at $1.4T valuation

articles.title: 马斯克xAI抢注dot.com域名
articles.summary: OpenAI发布Dots前，马斯克的xAI已买下dot.com域名，现在跳转到Grok聊天机器人下载页。
articles.why: AI公司之间的竞争越来越像「抢地盘」，普通人能看到产品之外的商业博弈。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 当八卦看就好，重点是各家AI助手会因此变得更好用还是更贵。
articles.source_title: The internet is convinced Elon Musk’s xAI trolled OpenAI’s ‘Dots’ launch

articles.title: OpenAI开发者大会场外有抗议
articles.summary: OpenAI年度开发者大会开幕当天，多个组织在场外抗议，喊出「人民高于利润」等口号。
articles.why: AI快速发展同时，普通人对就业、电价等问题的担忧也在增加，值得了解不同声音。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 可以想一想：AI带来的好处和代价，分别由谁承担？

plain_summary: OpenAI在开发者大会推出由GPT-6 Astra驱动的常驻后台智能体Dots，并发布一批办公功能，使ChatGPT可直接处理文档表格；CEO奥特曼称公司要等能对模型安全作出更可靠承诺后才考虑上市，同时据报道正洽谈300亿美元融资、估值1.4万亿美元。特朗普签署行政令，要求联邦文件统一改称AI为「超级智能」。DeepSeek推出主打插件化的Harness桌面预览版。多位来自OpenAI、谷歌、Anthropic的研究者发视频警告超级智能风险。xAI被指抢注dot.com域名，OpenAI大会场外出现抗议。

top_starred.name: affaan-m/ECC
top_starred.desc: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
top_starred.tagline: 为多种 AI 编程助手做性能优化的工具系统
top_starred.explanation: 这是一个面向 Claude Code、Codex、Opencode、Cursor 等 AI 编程助手的性能优化系统，描述提到它涉及技能、本能、记忆、安全和研究优先的开发方式。简单说，它想让你在写代码时用的 AI 助手跑得更好、更聪明。适合已经在用这些编程助手、希望进一步提升效率的开发者。项目描述信息有限，具体怎么安装、支持哪些平台，请查看原项目确认。

top_starred.name: NousResearch/hermes-agent
top_starred.desc: The agent that grows with you
top_starred.tagline: 一个会随你一起成长的 AI 智能体
top_starred.explanation: 这是 NousResearch 推出的智能体项目，官方描述只有一句「与你共同成长的智能体」。从字面看，它强调随着使用时间增加，能逐渐适应你的需求。适合对 AI 智能体感兴趣、想尝试个人助手类工具的人。但项目描述信息有限，它具体能做什么、怎么用、需要什么条件，请查看原项目确认。

top_starred.name: Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT
top_starred.desc: AutoGPT is the vision of accessible AI for everyone, to use and to build on. Our mission is to provide the tools, so that you can focus on what matters.
top_starred.tagline: 让每个人都能使用和搭建 AI 的开源项目
top_starred.explanation: AutoGPT 的目标是让 AI 对所有人都触手可及，既可以直接使用，也可以在其基础上继续开发。它的使命是提供工具，让你专注于真正重要的事情。适合想体验自主 AI 智能体、或想基于现成框架做二次开发的用户。例如可以设想用它来自动完成一些多步骤任务。具体功能和运行要求请查看原项目确认。

top_starred.name: firecrawl/firecrawl
top_starred.desc: 🔥 Supercharge your AI agents with data from the web and beyond. A web data API to search, scrape, and access more sources.
top_starred.tagline: 给 AI 智能体提供网页数据的接口工具
top_starred.explanation: Firecrawl 是一个网页数据 API，可以搜索、抓取网页，并访问更多数据来源，用来给 AI 智能体补充外部信息。比如你做的 AI 助手需要读取某个网站的最新内容时，可以用它来获取。适合开发者、需要让 AI 联网取数的团队。项目描述信息有限，具体支持哪些网站、如何接入，请查看原项目确认。

top_starred.name: ollama/ollama
top_starred.desc: Get up and running with Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, DeepSeek, gpt-oss, Qwen, Gemma and other models.
top_starred.tagline: 在本地运行多种大模型的工具
top_starred.explanation: Ollama 让你能快速跑起 Kimi、GLM、MiniMax、DeepSeek、gpt-oss、Qwen、Gemma 等多种大模型。它的价值在于把模型运行这件事变简单，适合想在自己电脑上试用各种开源模型、又不想折腾复杂环境的人。例如可以设想用它本地跑一个问答模型。具体支持哪些系统和硬件，请查看原项目确认。

trending.name: jev-chat/jev-chat-jarvis
trending.desc: 装在手机上的对话副驾：在 QQ / X / 飞书里读懂对方、给出候选回复、一键填入输入框，发不发由你。非侵入，只读屏幕，不 hook 不改包。
trending.tagline: 手机上的聊天副驾，帮你生成回复建议
trending.explanation: 这是一个装在手机上的对话辅助工具，能在 QQ、X、飞书里读懂对方消息，给出候选回复，并一键填入输入框，发不发由你决定。它强调非侵入：只读屏幕，不 hook、不改包。适合经常在这些平台聊天、想提高回复效率的人。例如收到消息后可以先看它给的几个候选回复再决定。具体支持机型和平台请查看原项目确认。

trending.name: KKKKhazix/AIHOT
trending.desc: 一个自己找热点、自己写日报的网站框架。把信源和精选标准换成你的，它就是你的行业热点站。
trending.tagline: 自动找热点、自动写日报的网站框架
trending.explanation: 这是一个网站框架，能自己搜集热点、自己生成日报。你可以把信源和精选标准换成自己的，它就变成你所在行业的热点站。适合想做一个垂直领域资讯站、又不想每天手动整理内容的人。例如做 AI 行业热点站，让它每天自动汇总。具体怎么部署、支持哪些信源，请查看原项目确认。

trending.name: yetone/magpie
trending.desc: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.
trending.tagline: 在菜单栏统一管理各智能体的模型配置
trending.explanation: Magpie 是一个菜单栏工具，让你把不同 AI 智能体用的模型集中在一处管理，比如让 Codex 用 DeepSeek、让 Claude Code 用 Kimi。适合同时使用多个编程助手、想灵活切换背后模型的人。例如你可以在菜单栏里快速改某个助手调用的模型。具体支持哪些助手和模型，请查看原项目确认。

trending.name: yibie/awesome-jev
trending.desc: A curated list of public projects, integrations, and discussions built on Jev — TypeSafe AI's System One model for typed decisions.
trending.tagline: Jev 相关公开项目的精选清单
trending.explanation: 这是一个整理 Jev 生态的清单，收集了基于 Jev 构建的公开项目、集成方式和讨论。Jev 被描述为 TypeSafe AI 的 System One 模型，用于类型化决策。适合想了解 Jev 能做什么、有哪些现成项目可参考的人。它本身是资源列表，不是可直接运行的工具。具体收录内容和更新情况请查看原项目确认。

trending.name: nokia-applied-research/AnyJev
trending.desc: Turn any LLM into a Jev-style decision model: typed decisions, real probabilities, no training. (continue updating, welcome any issue and PR request)
trending.tagline: 把任意大模型变成类型化决策模型
trending.explanation: AnyJev 能把任意 LLM 转成 Jev 风格的决策模型，特点是类型化决策、输出真实概率，而且不需要训练。适合想让大模型给出结构化、带概率的决策结果，又不想投入训练成本的开发者。例如可以设想用它做分类或判断类任务。项目仍在持续更新，具体能力和用法请查看原项目确认。

items.title_en: Post-Training Leaves Behavioral Shadows on Unrelated Decisions
items.summary: We find that language models can transfer capabilities through task-unrelated text. Post-training typically improves language models using task-specific data. Prior work on subliminal learning shows that information about these updates can pass through unrelated generations, but has largely focused on traits or preferences using extensive teacher outputs. We introduce Active Taskless Distillation (ATD), which achieves capability transfer using only a single word from the teacher per prompt. ATD
items.title_cn: 后训练会在无关决策上留下行为阴影
items.note: 发现语言模型能通过任务无关文本传递能力，仅需教师一个词即可实现迁移。

items.title_en: YuE2: Unifying Symbolic and Audio Music Generation at Frontier Quality
items.summary: Symbolic models make melody, harmony, rhythm, and form explicit but typically stop before a finished recording; audio models produce complete songs while leaving composition implicit. We introduce YuE2, which unifies symbolic and audio music generation at frontier quality through symbolic planning. A single AR-NAR Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) first writes a readable score specifying melody and harmony, expands it into semantic music tokens, and realizes it as full-song audio. items.title_cn: YuE2：统一符号与音频音乐生成达到前沿质量
items.note: 用符号规划统一乐谱与音频生成，先写谱再扩展为语义标记并合成整首歌。

items.title_en: Beyond Teacher Assignment: Domain-Normalized Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
items.summary: Reinforcement learning can turn one language model into several specialists, each excellent at a single skill such as mathematics, coding or following instructions, but users need one model with all of these skills. Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) merges them by letting the specialists teach one student: the student answers each prompt, and the specialist for that prompt's domain gives feedback on every token. items.title_cn: 超越教师分配：领域归一化多教师在线策略蒸馏
items.note: 指出多教师蒸馏中路由决定谁教，但未决定教学强度，提出领域归一化方法。

items.title_en: Groupwise Agentic Grading and Advantage Redistribution for Code Agent RL
items.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for code agents often uses executable tests to provide binary rewards. With these rewards, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) assigns identical advantages to test-passing trajectories within each rollout group, overlooking differences in implementation quality and adherence to task requirements. This leaves the policy without a learning signal that favors clean, targeted implementations over those containing unnecessary or out-of-scope changes. We introduce GAG
items.title_cn: 面向代码智能体强化学习的分组智能评分与优势重分配
items.note: 针对GRPO对通过测试轨迹给相同优势的问题，提出区分实现质量的重分配方法。

items.title_en: Self-Evolving Coding Agents: From Digital Programs to Physical-World Intelligence
items.summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action (WAM) models map observations and instructions directly to robot actions. This directness ties a policy to training: minor layout or viewpoint changes cause failure, and instructions generalize poorly. The root cause lies in representation: task requirements, conditions, progress, and failure recovery are implicitly encoded in action sequences, making them difficult to inspect or revise. Digital coding agents offer a precedent: LLMs call tools, verif
items.title_cn: 自进化编程智能体：从数字程序到物理世界智能
items.note: 借鉴编程智能体调用工具与验证的模式，让机器人策略可检查、可修改。

items.title_en: FuseReg: Regularizing Layer Fusion Mitigates the Reconstruction-Generation Gap in Representation Autoencoders
items.summary: Representation autoencoders (RAEs) reuse features from a pretrained visual encoder as reconstruction and diffusion latents, integrating strong visual representations into image generation. However, RAEs still need to decide which encoder layers form the shared latent space for the generator and pixel decoder. This choice involves a trade-off. items.title_cn: FuseReg：正则化层融合缓解表示自编码器的重建-生成差距
items.note: 针对RAE中浅层保细节、深层利生成的权衡，提出正则化层融合方法。

items.title_en: Disaggregated Quantization: Specializing LLM Prefill and Decode
items.summary: Prefill and decode reward different approaches to quantization: low-precision arithmetic accelerates prompt processing, while compact weights reduce memory traffic during generation. We propose "disaggregated quantization" (DQ), which specializes computation formats, weights and storage placement to both of these phases. On Qwen 3 and Gemma 3, removing activation quantization specifically on decode improves accuracy on decode-heavy tasks without increasing inference cost. Training separate compu
items.title_cn: 分离式量化：专门化LLM预填充与解码
items.note: 根据预填充与解码不同需求，分别专门化计算格式、权重与存储位置。

items.title_en: RayOrch: Programming and Executing Lineage-Controlled Multi-Grain Dataflows for Foundation-Model Data Preparation
items.summary: Preparing high quality training data for foundation models requires scalable pipelines that transform heterogeneous documents and videos into structured records. Such pipelines expand each parent item into an ordered and input dependent sequence of children, whose counts may be long tailed. GPUs should batch children across parents while preserving parent relationships, child order, completion status, and result routing. Existing systems either hide parallelism behind coarse grained jobs or expo
items.title_cn: RayOrch：面向基础模型数据准备的血缘控制多粒度数据流
items.note: 解决数据准备中父子项血缘、顺序与批处理难以兼顾的可扩展流水线问题。

items.title_en: Block Sparse Attention with Log-Linear Complexity
items.summary: Scaling language models to long contexts is limited by the quadratic cost of self-attention. Block sparse attention offers an efficient alternative, but selecting the retained blocks remains a bottleneck. Conventional block selection requires scoring all query-block pairs and therefore remains quadratic in sequence length. To address this issue, we propose PISA, a block-sparse attention mechanism that employs a pyramid Top-K selection strategy. The main idea is to gradually narrow down the candi
items.title_cn: 对数线性复杂度的块稀疏注意力
items.note: 提出PISA金字塔Top-K选择，避免全查询-块打分，降低长上下文注意力成本。

items.title_en: TimeEvo: Failure-Driven Self-Evolution of a Time Series Agent
items.summary: Time series agents answer analytical questions by calling external tools, and which tools they carry is decided by people before the agent runs. However, we identify two failures in this setup. Human-Agent Tool Misalignment: a library of 21 expert-curated tools helps on some tasks and hurts on others, dropping anomaly accuracy under every backbone we test. Silent Harm: one round of generic self-revision changes 147 answers and breaks 56 of them, while the final score moves by less than a point.
items.title_cn: TimeEvo：时间序列智能体的失败驱动自进化
items.note: 发现人工工具集与智能体错配及静默伤害问题，提出失败驱动的自进化方法。

items.title_en: Training Object Permanence in World Models
items.summary: Object permanence and solidity are hallmarks of human cognitive priors. Recent studies show that video generation models, a paradigmatic class of current world models, have begun to show emerged reasoning abilities, making them ideal candidates for building human-like physical intelligence. Do video models have emerged object permanence in them? If not, could we train them with a core-cognition inspired dataset? We introduce WROP (World Reasoning with Object Permanence), a data infrastructure of
items.title_cn: 在世界模型中训练客体永久性
items.note: 提出WROP数据基础设施，探究并训练视频世界模型具备客体永久性认知先验。

items.title_en: Your Transformer Can Hold Two Thoughts at Once: Evidence of Linear Superposition in LLMs
items.summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) rely on highly non-linear components, in this work we demonstrate that they exhibit fundamental linearity: when inputs from distinct text streams are linearly combined, the model outputs a superposition of the individual next-token distributions. We term this the Superposition Linearity Hypothesis. We provide evidence that superposition is an intrinsic property of the Transformer architecture rather than an emergent consequence of training; in fact, we observe
items.title_cn: 你的Transformer能同时持有两个想法：LLM中线性叠加的证据
items.note: 发现不同文本流线性组合时，模型输出为各自下一词分布的叠加。

items.title_en: WanPE: Towards Cinematic Prompt Enhancement for Modern Text-to-Video Generation
items.summary: Video generation begins in text space by authoring a cinematic screenplay, then materializes into pixels. As contemporary video generators scale to 30 seconds and faithfully follow complex conditions, the textual prompt largely directs the production, planning how actions, camera trajectories, lighting, and sound unfold across multi-shot sequences. In this paper, we present WanPE, a 397B-parameter prompt enhancement model trained on 1.05M real-world videos to master director-level cinematic plan
items.title_cn: WanPE：面向现代文生视频的电影级提示增强
items.note: 训练397B提示增强模型，把文本提示提升为导演级电影化多镜头规划。

items.title_en: Agent-Editing World Model: Rethinking World Modeling for LLM Agents
items.summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled agents to tackle long-horizon tasks across diverse environments. To further improve agent performance, existing language world models typically predict environment observations, yet reconstructing high-entropy, execution-dependent tool responses offers limited value when real feedback is available. Meanwhile, agents suffer from task-state contamination, where unsupported assumptions and outdated plans persist in history and distort sub
items.title_cn: 智能体编辑世界模型：重新思考LLM智能体的世界建模
items.note: 指出预测工具响应价值有限，转而让世界模型编辑智能体状态以清除污染。

items.title_en: Rufus-Air: An Open LLM Post-Training Recipe
items.summary: Rufus-Air is an open and reproducible post-training recipe on GLM-4.5-Air-Base (106B-A12B), organized as a serial pipeline of eight stages: SFT, Reasoning RL, Coding RL, Instruction-Following RL, General Agent, Coding Agent, Search Agent, and RLHF. We document the data, reward design, infrastructure, stage order, and stagewise results needed to reproduce the recipe. Stages progress from basic to advanced capabilities and from hard, verifiable rewards to softer judge-based signals. Training build
items.title_cn: Rufus-Air：一个开放LLM后训练配方
items.note: 公开可复现的八阶段后训练流水线，涵盖SFT、多种RL与智能体训练。

items.title_en: SpeakerMem-R1: Speaker-Centered Dual-Track Memory for Multi-Party Dialogue
items.summary: Long-term conversational memory in multi-party settings requires more than retrieving relevant content from long-term conversations: it must distinguish who said what, whom each statement concerns, how individuals perceive one another, what information is shared by the group, and how states change over time. Recent studies on multi-party dialogue benchmarks show that existing general-purpose LLM memory systems tend to lose person and group relations or struggle to integrate clues distributed acr
items.title_cn: SpeakerMem-R1：面向多方对话的以说话人为中心双轨记忆
items.note: 针对多方对话需区分谁说了什么及人物关系，提出双轨记忆机制。

items.title_en: The Past Frames the Future: Memory for Autoregressive Video Generation
items.summary: Advances in generative models have improved video fidelity, enabling long-horizon generation, interactive world modeling, and evolving visual environments. Autoregressive (AR) video generation extends visual sequences through causal rollouts. However, a fundamental bottleneck emerges: as the generated sequence expands, practical models must operate under strictly bounded context windows, storage, and computational limits. Consequently, critical historical information, e.g., entity identities, dy
items.title_cn: 过去塑造未来：自回归视频生成的记忆
items.note: 针对自回归视频生成上下文受限导致历史信息丢失，研究记忆机制。

items.title_en: Spatial-Interactor: Learning Spatial Reasoning through Interaction with the Observable Physical World
items.summary: Spatial reasoning is essential for vision-language models (VLMs) to understand and act in the physical world. Reasoning in dynamic environments requires VLMs to perceive local state transitions caused by object motion and viewpoint changes and integrate them over long trajectories to maintain an updated spatial state, yet existing VLMs remain limited in both capabilities. Current spatial training primarily focuses on static questions about object attributes and spatial relations, providing limit
items.title_cn: Spatial-Interactor：通过与环境交互学习空间推理
items.note: 让VLM感知物体运动与视角变化引起的局部状态转移并长期整合。

items.title_en: HappyWorld-Bench
items.summary: Evaluating world models requires assessing both the quality of the worlds they generate and their consistency and responsiveness under exploration, interaction, and modification. We introduce HappyWorld-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark that evaluates whether generated worlds remain reliable as agents interact with them. Our design is built on a hierarchical capability framework of six world capabilities (W1-W6), from generative construction to unified world modeling, instantiated across three in
items.title_cn: HappyWorld-Bench
items.note: 提出六项世界能力框架的基准，评估生成世界在交互与修改下是否可靠。

items.title_en: Just-in-Time Memory: Learning to Curate Task-Adaptive Memory for LLM Agents
items.summary: Agentic memory systems reuse past experience to improve future performance, yet most existing designs curate memory at write time: once a task is completed, its trajectory is distilled into a fixed artifact, such as a reflection, workflow, skill, or reasoning strategy, that is later retrieved by similarity. This forces the system to decide what is worth remembering before the future query is known, irreversibly discarding information and producing a query-independent summary that must serve many
items.title_cn: 即时记忆：为LLM智能体学习策展任务自适应记忆
items.note: 指出写入时策展记忆会不可逆丢弃信息，提出按未来查询即时策展记忆。

items.title_en: The Tasteful Agent: Measuring and Improving Taste in Long-Horizon Tasks
items.summary: LLM agents increasingly work on long-horizon tasks, and the decisions they make along the way, such as which hypothesis to test or which implementation to build on, determine the outcome of the whole run. Making these decisions well is becoming a key capability for both engineering and research agents. We refer to the ability to make good long-horizon decisions as the taste of an agent. While existing benchmarks measure the end-to-end success of agents on long-horizon tasks, none of them measure
items.title_cn: 有品味的智能体：长程任务中品味的测量与提升
items.note: 提出智能体长程决策的“品味”概念，并构建测量与改进方法。

items.title_en: RULER: Instance-aware Rubric Rewards for SVG Generation
items.summary: Generating Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) code from natural-language instructions is an open-ended task without absolute visual ground truth, leaving both evaluation and policy optimization without a faithful signal. Scalar metrics (CLIP, Aesthetic) calibrated on natural images transfer poorly to stylized vector content, and reusing them as RL rewards triggers reward hacking. We address both limitations with rubric-based scoring. We first establish empirically that prompting a vision-language ju
items.title_cn: RULER：面向SVG生成的实例感知评分标准奖励
items.note: 针对SVG生成缺乏可靠评估与奖励信号，提出基于评分标准的打分方法。

items.title_en: Ovis-Embedding: Pushing the Frontiers of Universal Omni-Modal Embeddings
items.summary: In this report, we introduce Ovis-Embedding, a state-of-the-art omni-modal embedding family built on native integration of text, image, video, and audio. Instead of assembling separate modality towers, Ovis-Embedding uses a shared multimodal backbone to encode different modalities in a common representation space. Specifically, we make three key advances: (1) native omni-modal initialization: we adopt a pretrained Qwen-omni model as the embedding backbone and adapt it through contrastive trainin
items.title_cn: Ovis-Embedding：推进通用全模态嵌入前沿
items.note: 基于共享多模态骨干原生整合文本、图像、视频与音频的嵌入模型。

items.title_en: GAE: Learning a Geometry-Native Latent Space for 3D-Consistent World Generation
items.summary: We present a compact geometry-native latent space as a shared foundation for perception and generation. Visual generators can produce photorealistic frames without preserving a consistent 3D scene. We argue that this is not only a modeling problem but also a representation problem: generators typically evolve appearance-centric latents, while perception models recover geometry in a semantically rich space that encodes cross-view structure. Rather than adding geometry as another output, we repara
items.title_cn: GAE：为3D一致世界生成学习几何原生隐空间
items.note: 把几何作为共享隐空间而非额外输出，以提升生成场景的3D一致性。

items.title_en: StableVQ: Practical Guidelines for Stable Vector-Quantized Tokenizer Training
items.summary: Vector Quantization (VQ) is fundamental to discrete visual tokenizers that power modern autoregressive and masked image generation models. While recent shared-projection codebook methods have substantially advanced codebook utilization, training stability remains a critical and underexplored challenge. We argue that the root cause lies in the entanglement of the Encoder--Decoder and Codebook training: because neither module can reliably fulfill its own responsibility in isolation, the system can
items.title_cn: StableVQ：稳定向量量化分词器训练的实用指南
items.note: 指出编解码器与码本训练纠缠是稳定性根因，给出稳定训练指南。

items.title_en: OmniEdu: Open Foundation Models for Learning and Teaching
items.summary: Educational foundation models must solve problems, understand curriculum structure, diagnose learner difficulties, and provide appropriate instructional support. Existing educational language models often focus on either problem solving or tutoring, with training mixtures organized by source or task rather than capability. We present OmniEdu, an open family of foundation models for K-12 learning and teaching. Its instruction-tuning corpus combines over 100 educational resources and general instr
items.title_cn: OmniEdu：面向学与教的开放基础模型
items.note: 构建按能力组织、覆盖K-12学习与教学的开放教育基础模型家族。

items.title_en: Realtime-Venus: A full-duplex interaction system with asynchronous delegation
items.summary: Natural interaction in digital and physical environments requires continuous perception and timely responses. Spoken dialogue relies on acoustic and linguistic cues, while video interaction also requires grounding the conversation in evolving visual context. We present Realtime-Venus, a proactive full-duplex interaction system with two separately trained 9B models: Realtime-Venus-Omni for audio-visual interaction and Realtime-Venus-Audio for spoken interaction. Each model serves as a complete co
items.title_cn: Realtime-Venus：带异步委托的全双工交互系统
items.note: 用两个9B模型分别处理音视频与语音交互，实现主动全双工对话。

items.title_en: RRSI: Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses
items.summary: An LLM agent's capability is largely magnified by its harness, namely the prompts, control flow, tooling, memory, and context management surrounding the frozen backbone model. Recent methods increasingly automate this process by iteratively proposing and selecting component-wise edits of an agent harness, practically establishing a form of recursive self-improvement (RSI) at the agent-system level. However, such recursive evolution may overfit by memorizing the training tasks, showing large in-d
items.title_cn: RRSI：智能体框架的正则化递归自我改进
items.note: 针对智能体框架递归自改易过拟合，提出正则化方法提升泛化。

items.title_en: WorldCrafter: Consistent Video World Model with Implicit 3D-aware Memory
items.summary: Video world models enable interactive exploration of dynamic environments, yet struggle to respect prior observations over long horizons and across viewpoints. We present WorldCrafter, a video world model that learns a camera-queryable implicit 3D-aware memory for this purpose. The key insight is to let the requested viewpoint shape how multi-view evidence is compressed into the video generator's limited token budget. Trained jointly with the video generator, a memory encoder and pose-conditione
items.title_cn: WorldCrafter：具隐式3D感知记忆的一致视频世界模型
items.note: 学习可相机查询的隐式3D记忆，让视角决定多视图证据压缩方式。

items.title_en: GameHorizon Suite: Multi-Horizon Data and Evaluation in Gameplay
items.summary: Modern video games provide a measurable testbed for AI models, combining abilities of visual understanding, instruction decomposition, goal planning, and precise action control over multiple temporal horizons. Existing datasets and benchmarks, however, either cover a narrow range of games, lack language instructions, or rely on high-variance online rollouts. To address these challenges, we introduce GameHorizon, a unified data and evaluation suite that measures gameplay capabilities at different
items.title_cn: GameHorizon Suite：游戏玩法中的多时间跨度数据与评估
items.note: 构建统一数据与评估套件，在多个时间跨度上衡量游戏玩法能力。

items.title_en: EvoOntology: A Self-Evolving Ontology Layer for Data Agents
items.summary: Data agents aim to fulfill natural-language instructions over heterogeneous data, including tables, files, and databases. However, data agents face a challenging agent-data gap: heterogeneous data resides outside the agent, while the agent can access it (e.g., column names and file paths) only through generic tools. Existing approaches either let agents directly explore raw data sources or inject manually constructed semantic layers into prompts. However, neither scales well to large heterogeneo
items.title_cn: EvoOntology：面向数据智能体的自进化本体层
items.note: 针对智能体与异构数据间的鸿沟，提出自进化本体层来桥接语义。

items.title_en: OmniVChat: Synthesizing, Benchmarking, and Training for Native Audio-Visual Dialogue
items.summary: We define OmniVChat (Omni Video Chat) as the task of native audio-visual dialogue between a user and an omni model. In OmniVChat, omni models directly and simultaneously receive audio and video from a user and return text. The user's query is embedded in the audio and video, without a separate text question, external captioning, or speech recognition. Direct audio-visual input reduces external latency and computation while preserving perceptual cues. However, research on OmniVChat faces two cons
items.title_cn: OmniVChat：原生音视频对话的合成、基准与训练
items.note: 定义用户以音视频直接提问、模型直接回文本的原生音视频对话任务。

items.title_en: CodeMidas: Scaling Agentic Coding RL Environments from Code Itself
items.summary: Training capable coding agents via reinforcement learning (RL) requires diverse tasks with reliable verifiers. Open-source codebases offer a rich source of such tasks, while existing methods typically rely on development artifacts such as issues and commits, limiting the range of tasks that can be extracted. To better scale RL environments, we present CodeMidas, an agentic pipeline that turns implemented functionality in existing codebases into executable RL environments using source code as its
items.title_cn: CodeMidas：从代码本身扩展智能体编程RL环境
items.note: 用源代码中的已实现功能自动生成可执行RL环境，扩展编程智能体训练。

items.title_en: Grounded Skill Synthesis from Code at Scale for Agentic Intelligence
items.summary: Reusable skills give agents transferable procedural knowledge, making scalable acquisition essential for extending agents beyond prior experience. Existing methods face two limitations: trajectory-based synthesis requires interactions with specific environments, while document-derived skills may lack executable evidence and verification. Source code offers a complementary path: it requires no prior agent experience yet provides executable evidence for grounding abstractions. We present Code2Skil
items.title_cn: 从代码大规模合成有依据的技能以赋能智能体智能
items.note: 利用源代码提供可执行证据，规模化合成可复用、可验证的智能体技能。

items.title_en: RecreationWorld: Scalable and Verifiable Environments for Hybrid Computer-Use Agents
items.summary: Computer-use agents (CUAs) have advanced along two separate lines: graphical interaction and software development through code and the command line. Real digital work requires both, interleaved rather than stacked end to end. We study hybrid CUAs that autonomously decide when to explore an interface, implement software, and run and visually verify their artifacts. We introduce RecreationWorld, a five-platform framework built around recreation: given a running reference, an agent must discover it
items.title_cn: RecreationWorld：面向混合计算机使用智能体的可扩展可验证环境
items.note: 构建五平台框架，训练能交替探索界面、写代码并视觉验证的混合智能体。

huggingface.models_summary: 第 6 到 10 条这几个热门模型覆盖了文本分类、语音识别、文生图、图文问答等不同方向，说明当前热门模型不再只集中在聊天对话，而是往多模态和具体任务上铺开。其中 Qwen 系列图像模型反复出现，还衍生出加速版、无审查版和不同格式版本，反映出围绕一个基础模型做二次改造和轻量部署很活跃。对跟进 AI 圈和备考的人来说，值得注意模型任务类型的多样性，以及同一模型会有多种变体这一现象。
huggingface.papers_summary: 这批论文集中在几条主线：一是后训练与强化学习，如多教师蒸馏、代码智能体RL、开放后训练配方；二是智能体与记忆，包括长程决策、即时记忆、自进化框架；三是世界模型与视频生成，关注3D一致性、客体永久性和长时记忆；四是多模态与全模态嵌入、音视频对话；五是高效注意力与量化。新手可记住关键词：后训练、蒸馏、GRPO、智能体记忆、世界模型、多模态嵌入、块稀疏注意力。
